links.outcome: Stereotyping and demographic bias in AI-generated depictions of radiologists and technologists
links.effect: Radiologists depicted as male in 73.8% and White in 79.7% of outputs; MRTs more diverse; lack of disability/religious markers; only 56.2% of radiologist outputs role-appropriate versus 82.0% for MRTs.
links.quote: Radiologists were more often male (73.8%) and White (79.7%), while MRTs were more diverse.

screen.reason: Evaluates generative AI text-to-image/video models for accuracy, demographic bias, and stereotyping in depicting healthcare roles (radiologists vs. technologists) in patient-facing media.
